set.coverage_note: the tenancy's status under the Costa-Hawkins Act and whether another government agency regulates the rent

basis: This includes tenancies in newly constructed rental units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979, tenancies that are eligible for a rent increase under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act, and some tenancies where the rent is regulated by another government agency. Participant Guide §4.1 treats the cutoff as decidable from the year built except in the cutoff year, so tenancy-level conditions are reported as a note, not as unknown coverage.
source: starter-pack/participant-final-no-hour16 3/corpus/text/D079.txt; D080.txt: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
